acceptance.requirement: Generate byte-identical host sources from the same Binding IR.
acceptance.evidence: Generate each projection twice and compare every byte.

acceptance.requirement: Expose direct idiomatic declarations without public pointers, handles, or generic dispatch.
acceptance.evidence: Audit generated public source and compile a public API consumer.

acceptance.requirement: Compile generated bindings with the declared minimum host runtime.
acceptance.evidence: Run the host compiler in the pinned toolchain.

acceptance.requirement: Build byte-identical registry archives from one canonical release bundle.
acceptance.evidence: Build twice in separate roots and compare archive hashes.

acceptance.requirement: Install the archive into a clean ordinary package project with scripts disabled.
acceptance.evidence: Use the ecosystem package manager in an empty temporary root.

acceptance.requirement: Execute a declaration from the packaged Lean Alpha component through the generated API.
acceptance.evidence: Call copied values, resources, callbacks, and returned callables in the clean consumer.

acceptance.requirement: Match the Alpha semantic oracle shared by existing generated backends.
acceptance.evidence: Run the common copied-value, identity, lifecycle, callback, callable, and failure scenarios.

acceptance.requirement: Release owned resources explicitly and make repeated release harmless.
acceptance.evidence: Exercise close or dispose twice and confirm stale use fails predictably.

acceptance.requirement: Use one process-wide Lean runtime without packaging a private runtime per component.
acceptance.evidence: Load two independently packaged components and compare runtime identity.

acceptance.requirement: Reuse canonical native artifacts without a Lean, C, or linker step in registry packaging or install.
acceptance.evidence: Trace package construction and clean installation with compiler access disabled.

acceptance.requirement: Retain canonical component, Binding IR, runtime, graph, and artifact identities.
acceptance.evidence: Verify packaged hashes and receipt fields against the canonical manifest.

acceptance.requirement: Measure steady-state calls through the installed generated API.
acceptance.evidence: Publish operation, iterations, duration, per-call latency, and machine context.

publicConventions: immutable value types for copied records
sealed classes and IDisposable for owned resources
delegates for callbacks and returned callables
